title: ContentManifest
description: assets/content/manifest.json — the single place where the bundled content is versioned. The app re-seeds its local database when `contentVersion` is greater than the stored one (US-013).

schemaVersion.description: Version of the JSON contract (this folder of schemas). Current: 2 (US-015). Bumped only when the Dart models change incompatibly; the app refuses a bundle whose schemaVersion it does not know.

contentVersion.description: Monotonic counter of the content bundle. Bump on EVERY change under assets/content/ that must reach users (new items, corrected answers, new lessons). See AUTHORING.md.

updatedAt.description: Date of the last contentVersion bump (YYYY-MM-DD).

modules.description: Module folders present in the bundle, in display order.

changelog.description: Newest first. Keeps authors honest about what a bump contains.
